Hi Tim,

It's done. I've changed order Shop···· from the DC04 to the Hammer DC06 (330 MH/s). Georges covered the $80.99 difference, so you have nothing more to pay. The order stays fully paid.

The DC06 is in stock and ships within 2 business days. As soon as it leaves the warehouse, the tracking link will come to this email address. You'll also get an updated-order email from the store showing the change.

Thank you for your patience through all this. I'm sorry it took a month to get here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

**What I did:** I checked that the order is yours and that there's no dispute on it. Then I made the swap with the $80.99 waived, as Georges approved. A new warehouse order was created for the DC06, it isn't on hold, and the order owes $0.00. I also sent the team a note that the swap is done. No one needs to do anything else.

**Left out of the email on purpose:**
- **The $50 from Mike:** this order has no record of it. I treated it as covered by the $80.99 waiver, since that's what the last message to Tim said.
- **Trustpilot review request:** I didn't include one. Tim is grateful now, but he said his trust in us is very low after a month of silence, so asking felt premature.

handoffs: swap completed, for Abel's visibility per the swap procedure; nothing pending
